Odontotermes JatiguJa”, but are in fact entry 249 and the species name latigula. The original gives the soldier width/length ratio as “0.8~-0.96”, the last digit being incomplete, so it is not recorded; the original gives the lower limit of the alate body length without wings as “li.4”, so only the upper limit is recorded. sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light brown to chestnut brown; antennae pale yellowish brown, darker at the apex than at the base; mandibles reddish brown to dark brown; body and legs yellowish white, the pronotum sometimes slightly darker. Head pilosity sparse, body pilosity moderately dense. Body length 4.50–6.50 mm. Head capsule oval, longer than wide, length to the mandibular base 1.20–1.50, maximum width 1.15–1.40 mm; the maximum width about at the middle, the sides narrowing forwards, the width at the mandibular base 0.75–0.88 mm, its ratio to the maximum width 0.60–0.68. Antennae 16–17-segmented; with 16 segments segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2 and segment 4 shortest; with 17 segments segment 2 twice segment 3, segment 3 shortest and segment 4 slightly longer than segment 5. Labrum subtriangular, the apex pointed, slightly longer than wide. Mandibles sword-shaped, slightly hooked anteriorly, length 0.80–0.93 mm, the ratio to the head length 0.60–0.69. The left mandible with a pointed tooth at 1/3 from the distal end, the tooth distance 0.25–0.30 mm, the ratio of the tooth distance to the mandible length 0.30–0.34. The right mandible with a reduced tooth near the middle. Postmentum very wide, the sides strongly arched, slightly longer than wide, length 0.75–0.93, maximum width 0.55–0.70 mm, the width/length ratio 0.68–0.80, strongly swollen in lateral view. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin markedly concave, length 0.50–0.65, width 0.80–1.00 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head capsule pale yellowish brown to dark brown; antennae brown at the apex and yellowish brown at the base; postclypeus, pronotum and legs paler than the head. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.40–4.50 mm. Head capsule subsquare, wider than long, widest at the antennal insertions, length to the mandibular base 1.15–1.50, maximum width 1.30–1.60 mm. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus swollen, hairy, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin deeply concave, length 0.40–0.53, width 0.68–0.80 mm. Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, the posterior margin slightly concave; metanotum wider than the pronotum, the posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown, paler anteriorly; fontanelle plate pale yellowish brown; antennae brown; postclypeus pale yellowish brown; pronotum dark brown with a paler T-shaped mark; wings light brown; abdominal tergites brown, paler than the head and pronotum. Head and body densely hairy. Body length with wings 25.1–25.5 mm, without wings less than 12.6 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long, length to the mandibular base 1.8–1.82, width including the eyes 2.5–2.55 mm. Fontanelle plate small, suboval. Eyes subcircular, strongly convex, maximum diameter 0.64–0.68, minimum diameter 0.60–0.61 mm, adjacent to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli large, oval, convex, long diameter 0.33–0.38, short diameter 0.28–0.32 mm, their distance from the eye less than their short diameter, that is, 0.15–0.23 mm. Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3, 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus swollen, hairy, less than half as long as wide, length 0.40–0.45, width 1.05–1.15 mm. Pronotum subtrapezoidal, slightly narrower than the head width including the eyes, length 1.23–1.30, width 2.25–2.30 mm. Wings light brown, long and narrow, fore wing 22.0–22.5, hind wing 20.00–20.65 mm; the radial colour band arises from the radial vein near the middle of the wing membrane.
